name: SuperMotion
summary: Web app that turns product screenshots and screen recordings into promo videos with mockups, zooms and annotations.
description: A browser-based editor that turns a product screenshot or screen recording into a promo video. It adds browser and device mockups, smooth zoom and 3D tilt animations, text callouts and multi-scene transitions, and exports from hand-crafted templates. Free plan with watermark, or a $79 one-time lifetime license.
contains: 20+ easing options for zoom and 3D tilt animations
Safari, Chrome and iPhone device mockups
templates for X posts, Dribbble shots, product demos and newsletters
free plan with watermark, $79 one-time lifetime license
free browser tools: trim, crop, compress, merge, change speed
